question: What constitutes the seventeen-city domain of the peaceful level?
premises: The peaceful level has seventeen cities.
It is joined with the three cities of Vidyeśa and Sadāśiva.
It includes Bindu, Half-moon, and Nirodhikā.
It extends to the supreme Sauśiva and the Indhikā and other cities of the central channel.
inference: The śāntā level is defined as a seventeen-world domain spanning Vidyeśa-Sadāśiva cities and subtle principles up to the central-channel Sauśiva region.
uncertainties: The precise parsing of 'indhikādi' as a world-name series is inferred from context.
plain_english: The peaceful level has seventeen cities. It includes the three cities of the Vidyeśas and Sadāśiva, the principles Bindu, Half-moon, and Nirodhikā, and reaches up to the supreme Sauśiva and the Indhikā and other cities of the central channel.
